definitions.explanation: Describes a person who is accepting of others, not easily offended, and generous in spirit. Literally 'heart is wide.'

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{心|こころ}が{広|ひろ}い{人|ひと}だ。
{上司|じょうし}は{心|こころ}が{広|ひろ}くて、{失敗|しっぱい}しても{怒|おこ}らない。
examples.english: My boss is generous and doesn't get angry even when I make mistakes.

examples.japanese: {心|こころ}が{広|ひろ}い{人|ひと}は、{小|ちい}さなことで{文句|もんく}を{言|い}わない。
examples.english: A tolerant person doesn't complain about small things.

notes:
An idiomatic expression meaning broad-minded or generous. Literally '{心|こころ} (heart) が (is) {広|ひろ}い (wide).' Functions as an i-adjective phrase modifying nouns or as a predicate.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {心|こころ}が{広|ひろ}い{人|ひと}: a broad-minded person
- {心|こころ}が{広|ひろ}くて{優|やさ}しい: broad-minded and kind

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {心|こころ}が{狭|せま}い: narrow-minded, petty — the direct opposite
- {寛大|かんだい}な: generous, lenient — more formal; often used for official pardons or tolerance
- {器|うつわ}が{大|おお}きい: big-hearted — similar meaning using a different metaphor (vessel/container)
